answer: Proof of Burn acts as a jetty against malicious infiltration by requiring agents to destroy native tokens, creating a reef of economic friction that makes identity duplication prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale fake nodes must sacrifice genuine capital, which glows with the violet light of irretrievable loss. This mechanism ensures that the barrier to entry is tethered to tangible value, forcing agents to operate within the constraints of finite resource expenditure.
